targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 1 status AS [Status]
FROM dbo.device_status
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC

SELECT TOP 1
CASE
  WHEN os_version LIKE '%10.0.26200%' THEN 'Win 11 24H2+'
  WHEN os_version LIKE '%10.0.26120%' THEN 'Win 11 24H2+'
  WHEN os_version LIKE '%10.0.26100%' THEN 'Win 11 24H2'
  WHEN os_version LIKE '%10.0.25398%' THEN 'Win 11 23H2'
  WHEN os_version LIKE '%10.0.22631%' THEN 'Win 11 23H2'
  WHEN os_version LIKE '%10.0.22621%' THEN 'Win 11 22H2'
  WHEN os_version LIKE '%10.0.22000%' THEN 'Win 11 21H2'
  WHEN os_version LIKE '%10.0.19045%' THEN 'Win 10 22H2'
  WHEN os_version LIKE '%10.0.19044%' THEN 'Win 10 21H2'
  WHEN os_version LIKE '%10.0.19043%' THEN 'Win 10 21H1'
  WHEN os_version LIKE '%10.0.19042%' THEN 'Win 10 20H2'
  WHEN os_version LIKE '%10.0.19041%' THEN 'Win 10 2004'
  ELSE os_version
END AS [OS]
FROM dbo.device_os_status
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC

SELECT TOP 1 CAST(usage_percent AS decimal(5,1)) AS [C: Drive %]
FROM dbo.device_storage_status
WHERE device_id = ${machine} AND drive = 'C:'
ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_items),0) AS [Items Today]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
AND CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime) AS date) = CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, GETDATE()) AS date)

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(100.0*SUM(good_read)/NULLIF(SUM(total_items),0),0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS [Good Read %]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
AND CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime) AS date) = CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, GETDATE()) AS date)

SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(CAST(application_running AS int), -1) AS [App Running]
FROM dbo.device_application_status
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC
SELECT customer AS [Customer], location AS [Location] FROM dbo.devices WHERE id = ${machine}

SELECT TOP 1 CAST(mem_usage_pct AS decimal(5,1)) AS [Mem %]
FROM dbo.device_os_metrics
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC

SELECT TOP 1 CAST(temp_celsius AS decimal(5,1)) AS [Temp C]
FROM dbo.device_os_metrics
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC

SELECT TOP 1 uptime_seconds AS [Uptime]
FROM dbo.device_uptime_status
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(100.0*SUM(item_out_of_spec)/NULLIF(SUM(total_items),0),0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS [Out of Spec %]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(100.0*SUM(more_than_1_item)/NULLIF(SUM(total_items),0),0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS [Multiple Items %]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(100.0*SUM(no_weight)/NULLIF(SUM(total_items),0),0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS [No Weight %]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(100.0*SUM(no_dimension)/NULLIF(SUM(total_items),0),0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS [No Dims %]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)

SELECT ts_datetime AS time, total_items AS [Total Items], good_read AS [Good Reads], no_read AS [No Reads]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)
ORDER BY ts_datetime

SELECT ts_datetime AS time,
  CAST(CASE WHEN total_items > 0 THEN 100.0*good_read/total_items ELSE NULL END AS decimal(6,2)) AS [Good Read %]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)
ORDER BY ts_datetime

SELECT x.drive AS [Drive], x.total_gb AS [Total GB], x.used_gb AS [Used GB], x.free_gb AS [Free GB], CAST(x.usage_percent AS decimal(5,1)) AS [Used %]
FROM (
  SELECT drive, total_gb, free_gb, used_gb, usage_percent,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY drive ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC) AS rn
  FROM dbo.device_storage_status
  WHERE device_id = ${machine}
) x WHERE x.rn = 1
ORDER BY x.drive

SELECT ts_datetime AS time, data_sent AS [Data Sent], not_sent AS [Not Sent]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${machine}
AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)
ORDER BY ts_datetime
